title: About
text: My experience spans research and industry: Amazon, WearOptimo, IMC, EY, and AgResearch. I completed my PhD at QUT, where my thesis on Bayesian Federated Learning received a QUT Outstanding Thesis Award. Prior to that, I completed two degrees at the University of Otago. Contact me at conorhassan.ai@gmail.com and connect with me on LinkedIn, X, and GitHub!

title: Conor Hassan
text: Conor Hassan. Machine Learning and Quantitative Researcher and Engineer. Selected publications include In-Context Multi-Objective Optimization, Efficient Autoregressive Inference for Transformer Probabilistic Models, Federated Variational Inference Methods for Structured Latent Variable Models, Deep Generative Models, Synthetic Tabular Data, and Differential Privacy, and Being Bayesian in the 2020s. Recent coding projects include AR-TabPFN.
